units.rightText: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me,

units.leftText: They looked to him, and were radiant.
units.rightText: They looked unto him, and were radiant;

units.leftText: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him,
units.rightText: This poor man cried, and Jehovah heard him,

units.leftText: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him,
units.rightText: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him,

units.leftText: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good.
units.rightText: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good:

units.leftText: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints,
units.rightText: Oh fear Jehovah, ye his saints;

units.leftText: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger,
units.rightText: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger;

units.leftText: Come, you children, listen to me.
units.rightText: Come, ye children, hearken unto me:

units.leftText: Who is someone who desires life,
units.rightText: What man is he that desireth life,

units.leftText: Keep your tongue from evil,
units.rightText: Keep thy tongue from evil,

units.leftText: Depart from evil, and do good.
units.rightText: Depart from evil, and do good;

units.leftText: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous.
units.rightText: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous,

units.leftText: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil,
units.rightText: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil,

units.leftText: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears,
units.rightText: The righteous cried, and Jehovah heard,

units.leftText: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart,
units.rightText: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart,

units.leftText: Many are the afflictions of the righteous,
units.rightText: Many are the afflictions of the righteous;

units.leftText: He protects all of his bones.
units.rightText: He keepeth all his bones:

units.leftText: Evil shall kill the wicked.
units.rightText: Evil shall slay the wicked;

units.leftText: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants.
units.rightText: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants;

units.leftText: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me.
units.rightText: Strive thou, O Jehovah, with them that strive with me:

units.leftText: Take hold of shield and buckler,
units.rightText: Take hold of shield and buckler,

units.leftText: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me.
units.rightText: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that pursue me:

units.leftText: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor.
units.rightText: Let them be put to shame and brought to dishonor that seek after my soul:

units.leftText: Let them be as chaff before the wind,
units.rightText: Let them be as chaff before the wind,

units.leftText: Let their way be dark and slippery,
units.rightText: Let their way be dark and slippery,

units.leftText: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me.
units.rightText: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit;

units.leftText: Let destruction come on him unawares.
units.rightText: Let destruction come upon him unawares;

units.leftText: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD.
units.rightText: And my soul shall be joyful in Jehovah:

units.leftText: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you,
units.rightText: All my bones shall say, Jehovah, who is like unto thee,

units.leftText: Unrighteous witnesses rise up.
units.rightText: Unrighteous witnesses rise up;

units.leftText: They reward me evil for good,
units.rightText: They reward me evil for good,

units.leftText: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth.
units.rightText: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth:

units.leftText: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother.
units.rightText: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother:

units.leftText: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together.
units.rightText: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together:

units.leftText: Like the profane mockers in feasts,
units.rightText: Like the profane mockers in feasts,

units.leftText: Lord, how long will you look on?
units.rightText: Lord, how long wilt thou look on?

units.leftText: I will give you thanks in the great assembly.
units.rightText: I will give thee thanks in the great assembly:

units.leftText: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me;
units.rightText: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me;

units.leftText: For they don’t speak peace,
units.rightText: For they speak not peace;

units.leftText: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me.
units.rightText: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me;

units.leftText: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent.
units.rightText: Thou hast seen it, O Jehovah; keep not silence:

units.leftText: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God!
units.rightText: Stir up thyself, and awake to the justice due unto me,

units.leftText: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness.
units.rightText: Judge me, O Jehovah my God, according to thy righteousness;

units.leftText: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!”
units.rightText: Let them not say in their heart, Aha, so would we have it:

units.leftText: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity.
units.rightText: Let them be put to shame and confounded together that rejoice at my hurt:

units.leftText: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad.
units.rightText: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favor my righteous cause:

units.leftText: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
units.rightText: And my tongue shall talk of thy righteousness

units.leftText: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked:
units.rightText: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart,

units.leftText: For he flatters himself in his own eyes,
units.rightText: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes,

units.leftText: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit.
units.rightText: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit:

units.leftText: He plots iniquity on his bed.
units.rightText: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed;

units.leftText: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens.
units.rightText: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens;

units.leftText: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God.
units.rightText: Thy righteousness is like the mountains of God;

units.leftText: How precious is your loving kindness, God!
units.rightText: How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God!

units.leftText: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house.
units.rightText: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house;

units.leftText: For with you is the spring of life.
units.rightText: For with thee is the fountain of life:

units.leftText: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you,
units.rightText: Oh continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee,

units.leftText: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me.
units.rightText: Let not the foot of pride come against me,

units.leftText: There the workers of iniquity are fallen.
units.rightText: There are the workers of iniquity fallen:

units.leftText: Don’t fret because of evildoers,
units.rightText: Fret not thyself because of evil-doers,

units.leftText: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass,
units.rightText: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass,

units.leftText: Trust in the LORD, and do good.
units.rightText: Trust in Jehovah, and do good;

units.leftText: Also delight yourself in the LORD,
units.rightText: Delight thyself also in Jehovah;

units.leftText: Commit your way to the LORD.
units.rightText: Commit thy way unto Jehovah;

units.leftText: he will make your righteousness shine out like light,
units.rightText: And he will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light,

units.leftText: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him.
units.rightText: Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him:

units.leftText: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath.
units.rightText: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath:

units.leftText: For evildoers shall be cut off,
units.rightText: For evil-doers shall be cut off;

units.leftText: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more.
units.rightText: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be:

units.leftText: But the humble shall inherit the land,
units.rightText: But the meek shall inherit the land,

units.leftText: The wicked plots against the just,
units.rightText: The wicked plotteth against the just,

units.leftText: The Lord will laugh at him,
units.rightText: The Lord will laugh at him;

units.leftText: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow,
units.rightText: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow,

units.leftText: Their sword shall enter into their own heart.
units.rightText: Their sword shall enter into their own heart,

units.leftText: Better is a little that the righteous has,
units.rightText: Better is a little that the righteous hath

units.leftText: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken,
units.rightText: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken;

units.leftText: The LORD knows the days of the perfect.
units.rightText: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect;

units.leftText: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil.
units.rightText: They shall not be put to shame in the time of evil;

units.leftText: But the wicked shall perish.
units.rightText: But the wicked shall perish,

units.leftText: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back,
units.rightText: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again;

units.leftText: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land.
units.rightText: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the land;

units.leftText: A man’s steps are established by the LORD.
units.rightText: A man’s goings are established of Jehovah;

units.leftText: Though he stumble, he shall not fall,
units.rightText: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down;

units.leftText: I have been young, and now am old,
units.rightText: I have been young, and now am old;

units.leftText: All day long he deals graciously, and lends.
units.rightText: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth;

units.leftText: Depart from evil, and do good.
units.rightText: Depart from evil, and do good;

units.leftText: For the LORD loves justice,
units.rightText: For Jehovah loveth justice,

units.leftText: The righteous shall inherit the land,
units.rightText: The righteous shall inherit the land,

units.leftText: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom.
units.rightText: The mouth of the righteous talketh of wisdom,

units.leftText: The law of his God is in his heart.
units.rightText: The law of his God is in his heart;

units.leftText: The wicked watch the righteous,
units.rightText: The wicked watcheth the righteous,

units.leftText: The LORD will not leave him in his hand,
units.rightText: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand,

units.leftText: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way,
units.rightText: Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way,

units.leftText: I have seen the wicked in great power,
units.rightText: I have seen the wicked in great power,

units.leftText: But he passed away, and behold, he was not.
units.rightText: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not:

units.leftText: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright,
units.rightText: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright;

units.leftText: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together.
units.rightText: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together:

units.leftText: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD.
units.rightText: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah:

units.leftText: The LORD helps them and rescues them.
units.rightText: And Jehovah helpeth them, and rescueth them:

units.leftText: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath,
units.rightText: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath;

units.leftText: For your arrows have pierced me,
units.rightText: For thine arrows stick fast in me,

units.leftText: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation,
units.rightText: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation;

units.leftText: For my iniquities have gone over my head.
units.rightText: For mine iniquities are gone over my head:

units.leftText: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt
units.rightText: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt,

units.leftText: I am in pain and bowed down greatly.
units.rightText: I am pained and bowed down greatly;

units.leftText: For my waist is filled with burning.
units.rightText: For my loins are filled with burning;

units.leftText: I am faint and severely bruised.
units.rightText: I am faint and sore bruised:

units.leftText: Lord, all my desire is before you.
units.rightText: Lord, all my desire is before thee;

units.leftText: My heart throbs.
units.rightText: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me:

units.leftText: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague.
units.rightText: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague;

units.leftText: They also who seek after my life lay snares.
units.rightText: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me;

units.leftText: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear.
units.rightText: But I, as a deaf man, hear not;

units.leftText: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear,
units.rightText: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not,

units.leftText: For I hope in you, LORD.
units.rightText: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope:

units.leftText: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me,
units.rightText: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me:

units.leftText: For I am ready to fall.
units.rightText: For I am ready to fall,

units.leftText: For I will declare my iniquity.
units.rightText: For I will declare mine iniquity;

units.leftText: But my enemies are vigorous and many.
units.rightText: But mine enemies are lively, and are strong;

units.leftText: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me,
units.rightText: They also that render evil for good

units.leftText: Don’t forsake me, LORD.
units.rightText: Forsake me not, O Jehovah:

units.leftText: Hurry to help me,
units.rightText: Make haste to help me,

units.leftText: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue.
units.rightText: I said, I will take heed to my ways,

units.leftText: I was mute with silence.
units.rightText: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good;

units.leftText: My heart was hot within me.
units.rightText: My heart was hot within me;

units.leftText: “LORD, show me my end,
units.rightText: Jehovah, make me to know mine end,

units.leftText: Behold, you have made my days hand widths.
units.rightText: Behold, thou hast made my days as handbreadths;

units.leftText: “Surely every man walks like a shadow.
units.rightText: Surely every man walketh in a vain show;

units.leftText: Now, Lord, what do I wait for?
units.rightText: And now, Lord, what wait I for?

units.leftText: Deliver me from all my transgressions.
units.rightText: Deliver me from all my transgressions:

units.leftText: I was mute.
units.rightText: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth;

units.leftText: Remove your scourge away from me.
units.rightText: Remove thy stroke away from me:

units.leftText: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity,
units.rightText: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity,

units.leftText: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry.
units.rightText: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry;

units.leftText: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength,
units.rightText: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength,

units.leftText: I waited patiently for the LORD.
units.rightText: I waited patiently for Jehovah;

units.leftText: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit,
units.rightText: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay;

units.leftText: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God.
units.rightText: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God:

units.leftText: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust,
units.rightText: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust,

units.leftText: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done,
units.rightText: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done,

units.leftText: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire.
units.rightText: Sacrifice and offering thou hast no delight in;

units.leftText: Then I said, “Behold, I have come.
units.rightText: Then said I, Lo, I am come;

units.leftText: I delight to do your will, my God.
units.rightText: I delight to do thy will, O my God;

units.leftText: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly.
units.rightText: I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness in the great assembly;

units.leftText: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart.
units.rightText: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart;

units.leftText: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD.
units.rightText: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah;

units.leftText: For innumerable evils have surrounded me.
units.rightText: For innumerable evils have compassed me about;

units.leftText: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me.
units.rightText: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me:

units.leftText: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it.
units.rightText: Let them be put to shame and confounded together

units.leftText: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
units.rightText: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame

units.leftText: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you.
units.rightText: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee:

units.leftText: But I am poor and needy.
units.rightText: But I am poor and needy;

units.leftText: Blessed is he who considers the poor.
units.rightText: Blessed is he that considereth the poor:

units.leftText: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive.
units.rightText: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive,

units.leftText: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed,
units.rightText: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing:

units.leftText: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me!
units.rightText: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me:

units.leftText: My enemies speak evil against me:
units.rightText: Mine enemies speak evil against me, saying,

units.leftText: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood.
units.rightText: And if he come to see me, he speaketh falsehood;

units.leftText: All who hate me whisper together against me.
units.rightText: All that hate me whisper together against me;

units.leftText: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him.
units.rightText: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him;

units.leftText: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted,
units.rightText: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted,

units.leftText: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up,
units.rightText: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up,

units.leftText: By this I know that you delight in me,
units.rightText: By this I know that thou delightest in me,

units.leftText: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity,
units.rightText: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity,

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel,
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel,

units.leftText: As the deer pants for the water brooks,
units.rightText: As the hart panteth after the water brooks,

units.leftText: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God.
units.rightText: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God:

units.leftText: My tears have been my food day and night,
units.rightText: My tears have been my food day and night,

units.leftText: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me,
units.rightText: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me,

units.leftText: Why are you in despair, my soul?
units.rightText: Why art thou cast down, O my soul?

units.leftText: My God, my soul is in despair within me.
units.rightText: O my God, my soul is cast down within me:

units.leftText: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls.
units.rightText: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterfalls:

units.leftText: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime.
units.rightText: Yet Jehovah will command his lovingkindness in the day-time;
leftNotes: 42:8 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me?
units.rightText: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me?

units.leftText: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me,
units.rightText: As with a sword in my bones, mine adversaries reproach me,

units.leftText: Why are you in despair, my soul?
units.rightText: Why art thou cast down, O my soul?

units.leftText: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation.
units.rightText: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation:

units.leftText: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me?
units.rightText: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off?

units.leftText: Oh, send out your light and your truth.
units.rightText: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me:

units.leftText: Then I will go to the altar of God,
units.rightText: Then will I go unto the altar of God,

units.leftText: Why are you in despair, my soul?
units.rightText: Why art thou cast down, O my soul?

units.leftText: We have heard with our ears, God;
units.rightText: We have heard with our ears, O God,

units.leftText: You drove out the nations with your hand,
units.rightText: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand;

units.leftText: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword,
units.rightText: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword,

units.leftText: God, you are my King.
units.rightText: Thou art my King, O God:

units.leftText: Through you, we will push down our adversaries.
units.rightText: Through thee will we push down our adversaries:

units.leftText: For I will not trust in my bow,
units.rightText: For I will not trust in my bow,

units.leftText: But you have saved us from our adversaries,
units.rightText: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries,

units.leftText: In God we have made our boast all day long.
units.rightText: In God have we made our boast all the day long,

units.leftText: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor,
units.rightText: But now thou hast cast us off, and brought us to dishonor,

units.leftText: You make us turn back from the adversary.
units.rightText: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary;

units.leftText: You have made us like sheep for food,
units.rightText: Thou hast made us like sheep appointed for food,

units.leftText: You sell your people for nothing,
units.rightText: Thou sellest thy people for nought,

units.leftText: You make us a reproach to our neighbors,
units.rightText: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors,

units.leftText: You make us a byword among the nations,
units.rightText: Thou makest us a byword among the nations,

units.leftText: All day long my dishonor is before me,
units.rightText: All the day long is my dishonor before me,

units.leftText: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses,
units.rightText: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth,

units.leftText: All this has come on us,
units.rightText: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee,

units.leftText: Our heart has not turned back,
units.rightText: Our heart is not turned back,

units.leftText: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals,
units.rightText: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals,

units.leftText: If we have forgotten the name of our God,
units.rightText: If we have forgotten the name of our God,

units.leftText: won’t God search this out?
units.rightText: Will not God search this out?

units.leftText: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long.
units.rightText: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long;

units.leftText: Wake up!
units.rightText: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord?

units.leftText: Why do you hide your face,
units.rightText: Wherefore hidest thou thy face,

units.leftText: For our soul is bowed down to the dust.
units.rightText: For our soul is bowed down to the dust:

units.leftText: Rise up to help us.
units.rightText: Rise up for our help,

units.leftText: My heart overflows with a noble theme.
units.rightText: My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter;

units.leftText: You are the most excellent of the sons of men.
units.rightText: Thou art fairer than the children of men;

units.leftText: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one,
units.rightText: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one,

units.leftText: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness.
units.rightText: And in thy majesty ride on prosperously,

units.leftText: Your arrows are sharp.
units.rightText: Thine arrows are sharp;

units.leftText: Your throne, God, is forever and ever.
units.rightText: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever:

units.leftText: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness.
units.rightText: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness:

units.leftText: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia.
units.rightText: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia;

units.leftText: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women.
units.rightText: Kings’ daughters are among thy honorable women:

units.leftText: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear.
units.rightText: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear;

units.leftText: So the king will desire your beauty,
units.rightText: So will the king desire thy beauty;

units.leftText: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift.
units.rightText: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift;

units.leftText: The princess inside is all glorious.
units.rightText: The king’s daughter within the palace is all glorious:

units.leftText: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work.
units.rightText: She shall be led unto the king in broidered work:

units.leftText: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led.
units.rightText: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led:

units.leftText: Your sons will take the place of your fathers.
units.rightText: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children,

units.leftText: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations.
units.rightText: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations:

units.leftText: God is our refuge and strength,
units.rightText: God is our refuge and strength,

units.leftText: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes,
units.rightText: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change,

units.leftText: though its waters roar and are troubled,

units.leftText: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered.
units.rightText: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered:

units.leftText: He has given food to those who fear him.
units.rightText: He hath given food unto them that fear him:

units.leftText: He has shown his people the power of his works,
units.rightText: He hath showed his people the power of his works,

units.leftText: The works of his hands are truth and justice.
units.rightText: The works of his hands are truth and justice;

units.leftText: They are established forever and ever.
units.rightText: They are established for ever and ever;

units.leftText: He has sent redemption to his people.
units.rightText: He hath sent redemption unto his people;

units.leftText: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
units.rightText: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 112:1 Hebrew: יה Yah. Psalm 112 is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise the LORD!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).

units.leftText: His offspring will be mighty in the land.
units.rightText: His seed shall be mighty upon earth:

units.leftText: Wealth and riches are in his house.
units.rightText: Wealth and riches are in his house;

units.leftText: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright,
units.rightText: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness:

units.leftText: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends.
units.rightText: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth;

units.leftText: For he will never be shaken.
units.rightText: For he shall never be moved;

units.leftText: He will not be afraid of evil news.
units.rightText: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings:

units.leftText: His heart is established.
units.rightText: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid,

units.leftText: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor.
units.rightText: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy;

units.leftText: The wicked will see it, and be grieved.
units.rightText: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 113:1 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD’s name,
units.rightText: Blessed be the name of Jehovah

units.leftText: From the rising of the sun to its going down,
units.rightText: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same

units.leftText: The LORD is high above all nations,
units.rightText: Jehovah is high above all nations,

units.leftText: Who is like the LORD, our God,
units.rightText: Who is like unto Jehovah our God,

units.leftText: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?
units.rightText: That humbleth himself to behold

units.leftText: He raises up the poor out of the dust,
units.rightText: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,

units.leftText: that he may set him with princes,
units.rightText: That he may set him with princes,

units.leftText: He settles the barren woman in her home
units.rightText: He maketh the barren woman to keep house,

units.leftText: When Israel went out of Egypt,
units.rightText: When Israel went forth out of Egypt,

units.leftText: Judah became his sanctuary,
units.rightText: Judah became his sanctuary,

units.leftText: The sea saw it, and fled.
units.rightText: The sea saw it, and fled;

units.leftText: The mountains skipped like rams,
units.rightText: The mountains skipped like rams,

units.leftText: What was it, you sea, that you fled?
units.rightText: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest?

units.leftText: You mountains, that you skipped like rams?
units.rightText: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams;

units.leftText: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord,
units.rightText: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord,

units.leftText: who turned the rock into a pool of water,
units.rightText: Who turned the rock into a pool of water,

units.leftText: Not to us, LORD, not to us,
units.rightText: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us,
leftNotes: 115:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Why should the nations say,
units.rightText: Wherefore should the nations say,

units.leftText: But our God is in the heavens.
units.rightText: But our God is in the heavens:

units.leftText: Their idols are silver and gold,
units.rightText: Their idols are silver and gold,

units.leftText: They have mouths, but they don’t speak.
units.rightText: They have mouths, but they speak not;

units.leftText: They have ears, but they don’t hear.
units.rightText: They have ears, but they hear not;

units.leftText: They have hands, but they don’t feel.
units.rightText: They have hands, but they handle not;

units.leftText: Those who make them will be like them;
units.rightText: They that make them shall be like unto them;

units.leftText: Israel, trust in the LORD!
units.rightText: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah:

units.leftText: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD!
units.rightText: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah:

units.leftText: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD!
units.rightText: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah:

units.leftText: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless us:

units.leftText: He will bless those who fear the LORD,
units.rightText: He will bless them that fear Jehovah,

units.leftText: May the LORD increase you more and more,
units.rightText: Jehovah increase you more and more,

units.leftText: Blessed are you by the LORD,
units.rightText: Blessed are ye of Jehovah,

units.leftText: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens,
units.rightText: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah;

units.leftText: The dead don’t praise the LORD,
units.rightText: The dead praise not Jehovah,
leftNotes: 115:17 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: but we will bless the LORD,
units.rightText: But we will bless Jehovah
leftNotes: 115:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice,
units.rightText: I love Jehovah, because he heareth
leftNotes: 116:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Because he has turned his ear to me,
units.rightText: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me,

units.leftText: The cords of death surrounded me,
units.rightText: The cords of death compassed me,

units.leftText: Then I called on the LORD’s name:
units.rightText: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah:

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious and righteous.
units.rightText: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous;

units.leftText: The LORD preserves the simple.
units.rightText: Jehovah preserveth the simple:

units.leftText: Return to your rest, my soul,
units.rightText: Return unto thy rest, O my soul;

units.leftText: For you have delivered my soul from death,
units.rightText: For thou hast delivered my soul from death,

units.leftText: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
units.rightText: I will walk before Jehovah

units.leftText: I believed, therefore I said,
units.rightText: I believe, for I will speak:

units.leftText: I said in my haste,
units.rightText: I said in my haste,

units.leftText: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
units.rightText: What shall I render unto Jehovah

units.leftText: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
units.rightText: I will take the cup of salvation,

units.leftText: I will pay my vows to the LORD,
units.rightText: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah,

units.leftText: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
units.rightText: Precious in the sight of Jehovah

units.leftText: LORD, truly I am your servant.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant:

units.leftText: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving,
units.rightText: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving,

units.leftText: I will pay my vows to the LORD,
units.rightText: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah,

units.leftText: in the courts of the LORD’s house,
units.rightText: In the courts of Jehovah’s house,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, all you nations!
units.rightText: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations;
leftNotes: 117:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: For his loving kindness is great toward us.
units.rightText: For his lovingkindness is great toward us;

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good;
leftNotes: 118:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Let Israel now say
units.rightText: Let Israel now say,

units.leftText: Let the house of Aaron now say
units.rightText: Let the house of Aaron now say,

units.leftText: Now let those who fear the LORD say
units.rightText: Let them now that fear Jehovah say,

units.leftText: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD.
units.rightText: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah:
leftNotes: 118:5 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid.
units.rightText: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear:

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side among those who help me.
units.rightText: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me:

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD,
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD,
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah

units.leftText: All the nations surrounded me,
units.rightText: All nations compassed me about:

units.leftText: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me.
units.rightText: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about:

units.leftText: They surrounded me like bees.
units.rightText: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns:

units.leftText: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall,
units.rightText: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall;

units.leftText: The LORD is my strength and song.
units.rightText: Jehovah is my strength and song;
leftNotes: 118:14 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous.
units.rightText: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous:

units.leftText: The right hand of the LORD is exalted!
units.rightText: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted:

units.leftText: I will not die, but live,
units.rightText: I shall not die, but live,

units.leftText: The LORD has punished me severely,
units.rightText: Jehovah hath chastened me sore;
leftNotes: 118:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Open to me the gates of righteousness.
units.rightText: Open to me the gates of righteousness:

units.leftText: This is the gate of the LORD;
units.rightText: This is the gate of Jehovah;

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me,
units.rightText: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me,

units.leftText: The stone which the builders rejected
units.rightText: The stone which the builders rejected

units.leftText: This is the LORD’s doing.
units.rightText: This is Jehovah’s doing;

units.leftText: This is the day that the LORD has made.
units.rightText: This is the day which Jehovah hath made;

units.leftText: Save us now, we beg you, LORD!
units.rightText: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah:

units.leftText: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name!
units.rightText: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah:

units.leftText: The LORD is God, and he has given us light.
units.rightText: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light:

units.leftText: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you.
units.rightText: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee:

units.leftText: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good;

units.leftText: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless,
units.rightText: Blessed are they that are perfect in the way,

units.leftText: Blessed are those who keep his statutes,
units.rightText: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies,

units.leftText: Yes, they do nothing wrong.
units.rightText: Yea, they do no unrighteousness;

units.leftText: You have commanded your precepts,
units.rightText: Thou hast commanded us thy precepts,

units.leftText: Oh that my ways were steadfast
units.rightText: Oh that my ways were established

units.leftText: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed,
units.rightText: Then shall I not be put to shame,

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart,
units.rightText: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart,

units.leftText: I will observe your statutes.
units.rightText: I will observe thy statutes:

units.leftText: How can a young man keep his way pure?
units.rightText: Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way?

units.leftText: With my whole heart I have sought you.
units.rightText: With my whole heart have I sought thee:

units.leftText: I have hidden your word in my heart,
units.rightText: Thy word have I laid up in my heart,

units.leftText: Blessed are you, LORD.
units.rightText: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah:

units.leftText: With my lips,
units.rightText: With my lips have I declared

units.leftText: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies,
units.rightText: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies,

units.leftText: I will meditate on your precepts,
units.rightText: I will meditate on thy precepts,

units.leftText: I will delight myself in your statutes.
units.rightText: I will delight myself in thy statutes:

units.leftText: Do good to your servant.
units.rightText: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live;

units.leftText: Open my eyes,
units.rightText: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold

units.leftText: I am a stranger on the earth.
units.rightText: I am a sojourner in the earth:

units.leftText: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
units.rightText: My soul breaketh for the longing

units.leftText: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed,
units.rightText: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed,

units.leftText: Take reproach and contempt away from me,
units.rightText: Take away from me reproach and contempt;

units.leftText: Though princes sit and slander me,
units.rightText: Princes also sat and talked against me;

units.leftText: Indeed your statutes are my delight,
units.rightText: Thy testimonies also are my delight

units.leftText: My soul is laid low in the dust.
units.rightText: My soul cleaveth unto the dust:

units.leftText: I declared my ways, and you answered me.
units.rightText: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me:

units.leftText: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts!
units.rightText: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts:

units.leftText: My soul is weary with sorrow;
units.rightText: My soul melteth for heaviness:

units.leftText: Keep me from the way of deceit.
units.rightText: Remove from me the way of falsehood;

units.leftText: I have chosen the way of truth.
units.rightText: I have chosen the way of faithfulness:

units.leftText: I cling to your statutes, LORD.
units.rightText: I cleave unto thy testimonies:

units.leftText: I run in the path of your commandments,
units.rightText: I will run the way of thy commandments,

units.leftText: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes.
units.rightText: Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes;

units.leftText: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law.
units.rightText: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law;

units.leftText: Direct me in the path of your commandments,
units.rightText: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments;

units.leftText: Turn my heart toward your statutes,
units.rightText: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies,

units.leftText: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things.
units.rightText: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity,

units.leftText: Fulfill your promise to your servant,
units.rightText: Confirm unto thy servant thy word,

units.leftText: Take away my disgrace that I dread,
units.rightText: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid;

units.leftText: Behold, I long for your precepts!
units.rightText: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts:

units.leftText: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD,
units.rightText: Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah,

units.leftText: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me,
units.rightText: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me;

units.leftText: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth,
units.rightText: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth;

units.leftText: So I will obey your law continually,
units.rightText: So shall I observe thy law continually

units.leftText: I will walk in liberty,
units.rightText: And I shall walk at liberty;

units.leftText: I will also speak of your statutes before kings,
units.rightText: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings,

units.leftText: I will delight myself in your commandments,
units.rightText: And I will delight myself in thy commandments,

units.leftText: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love.
units.rightText: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved;

units.leftText: Remember your word to your servant,
units.rightText: Remember the word unto thy servant,

units.leftText: This is my comfort in my affliction,
units.rightText: This is my comfort in my affliction;

units.leftText: The arrogant mock me excessively,
units.rightText: The proud have had me greatly in derision:

units.leftText: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD,
units.rightText: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah,

units.leftText: Indignation has taken hold on me,
units.rightText: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me,

units.leftText: Your statutes have been my songs
units.rightText: Thy statutes have been my songs

units.leftText: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night,
units.rightText: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night,

units.leftText: This is my way,
units.rightText: This I have had,

units.leftText: The LORD is my portion.
units.rightText: Jehovah is my portion:

units.leftText: I sought your favor with my whole heart.
units.rightText: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart:

units.leftText: I considered my ways,
units.rightText: I thought on my ways,

units.leftText: I will hurry, and not delay,
units.rightText: I made haste, and delayed not,

units.leftText: The ropes of the wicked bind me,
units.rightText: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round;

units.leftText: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you,
units.rightText: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee

units.leftText: I am a friend of all those who fear you,
units.rightText: I am a companion of all them that fear thee,

units.leftText: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD.
units.rightText: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness:

units.leftText: You have treated your servant well,
units.rightText: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant,

units.leftText: Teach me good judgment and knowledge,
units.rightText: Teach me good judgment and knowledge;

units.leftText: Before I was afflicted, I went astray;
units.rightText: Before I was afflicted I went astray;

units.leftText: You are good, and do good.
units.rightText: Thou art good, and doest good;

units.leftText: The proud have smeared a lie upon me.
units.rightText: The proud have forged a lie against me:

units.leftText: Their heart is as callous as the fat,
units.rightText: Their heart is as fat as grease;

units.leftText: It is good for me that I have been afflicted,
units.rightText: It is good for me that I have been afflicted;

units.leftText: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
units.rightText: The law of thy mouth is better unto me

units.leftText: Your hands have made me and formed me.
units.rightText: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me:

units.leftText: Those who fear you will see me and be glad,
units.rightText: They that fear thee shall see me and be glad,

units.leftText: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous,
units.rightText: I know, O Jehovah, that thy judgments are righteous,

units.leftText: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort,
units.rightText: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort,

units.leftText: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live;
units.rightText: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live;

units.leftText: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully.
units.rightText: Let the proud be put to shame; for they have overthrown me wrongfully:

units.leftText: Let those who fear you turn to me.
units.rightText: Let those that fear thee turn unto me;

units.leftText: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees,
units.rightText: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes,

units.leftText: My soul faints for your salvation.
units.rightText: My soul fainteth for thy salvation;

units.leftText: My eyes fail for your word.
units.rightText: Mine eyes fail for thy word,

units.leftText: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke.
units.rightText: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke;

units.leftText: How many are the days of your servant?
units.rightText: How many are the days of thy servant?

units.leftText: The proud have dug pits for me,
units.rightText: The proud have digged pits for me,

units.leftText: All of your commandments are faithful.
units.rightText: All thy commandments are faithful:

units.leftText: They had almost wiped me from the earth,
units.rightText: They had almost consumed me upon earth;

units.leftText: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness,
units.rightText: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness;

units.leftText: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.
units.rightText: For ever, O Jehovah,

units.leftText: Your faithfulness is to all generations.
units.rightText: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations:

units.leftText: Your laws remain to this day,
units.rightText: They abide this day according to thine ordinances;

units.leftText: Unless your law had been my delight,
units.rightText: Unless thy law had been my delight,

units.leftText: I will never forget your precepts,
units.rightText: I will never forget thy precepts;

units.leftText: I am yours.
units.rightText: I am thine, save me;

units.leftText: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me.
units.rightText: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me;

units.leftText: I have seen a limit to all perfection,
units.rightText: I have seen an end of all perfection;

units.leftText: How I love your law!
units.rightText: Oh how love I thy law!

units.leftText: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies,
units.rightText: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies;

units.leftText: I have more understanding than all my teachers,
units.rightText: I have more understanding than all my teachers;

units.leftText: I understand more than the aged,
units.rightText: I understand more than the aged,

units.leftText: I have kept my feet from every evil way,
units.rightText: I have refrained my feet from every evil way,

units.leftText: I have not turned away from your ordinances,
units.rightText: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances;

units.leftText: How sweet are your promises to my taste,
units.rightText: How sweet are thy words unto my taste!

units.leftText: Through your precepts, I get understanding;
units.rightText: Through thy precepts I get understanding:

units.leftText: Your word is a lamp to my feet,
units.rightText: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,

units.leftText: I have sworn, and have confirmed it,
units.rightText: I have sworn, and have confirmed it,

units.leftText: I am afflicted very much.
units.rightText: I am afflicted very much:

units.leftText: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth.
units.rightText: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah,

units.leftText: My soul is continually in my hand,
units.rightText: My soul is continually in my hand;

units.leftText: The wicked have laid a snare for me,
units.rightText: The wicked have laid a snare for me;

units.leftText: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever,
units.rightText: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever;

units.leftText: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever,
units.rightText: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes

units.leftText: I hate double-minded men,
units.rightText: I hate them that are of a double mind;

units.leftText: You are my hiding place and my shield.
units.rightText: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield:

units.leftText: Depart from me, you evildoers,
units.rightText: Depart from me, ye evil-doers,

units.leftText: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live.
units.rightText: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live;

units.leftText: Hold me up, and I will be safe,
units.rightText: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe,

units.leftText: You reject all those who stray from your statutes,
units.rightText: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes;

units.leftText: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross.
units.rightText: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross:

units.leftText: My flesh trembles for fear of you.
units.rightText: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee;

units.leftText: I have done what is just and righteous.
units.rightText: I have done justice and righteousness:

units.leftText: Ensure your servant’s well-being.
units.rightText: Be surety for thy servant for good:

units.leftText: My eyes fail looking for your salvation,
units.rightText: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation,

units.leftText: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness.
units.rightText: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness,

units.leftText: I am your servant. Give me understanding,
units.rightText: I am thy servant; give me understanding,

units.leftText: It is time to act, LORD,
units.rightText: It is time for Jehovah to work;

units.leftText: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold,
units.rightText: Therefore I love thy commandments

units.leftText: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right.
units.rightText: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right;

units.leftText: Your testimonies are wonderful,
units.rightText: Thy testimonies are wonderful;

units.leftText: The entrance of your words gives light.
units.rightText: The opening of thy words giveth light;

units.leftText: I opened my mouth wide and panted,
units.rightText: I opened wide my mouth, and panted;

units.leftText: Turn to me, and have mercy on me,

units.leftText: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.”
units.rightText: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God:

units.leftText: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
units.rightText: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation,

units.leftText: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked.
units.rightText: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked;

units.leftText: As for the head of those who surround me,
units.rightText: As for the head of those that compass me about,

units.leftText: Let burning coals fall on them.
units.rightText: Let burning coals fall upon them:

units.leftText: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth.
units.rightText: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth:

units.leftText: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
units.rightText: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted,

units.leftText: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name.
units.rightText: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name:

units.leftText: LORD, I have called on you.
units.rightText: Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me:

units.leftText: Let my prayer be set before you like incense;
units.rightText: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee;

units.leftText: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth.
units.rightText: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth;

units.leftText: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing,
units.rightText: Incline not my heart to any evil thing,

units.leftText: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness;
units.rightText: Let the righteous smite me, it shall be a kindness;

units.leftText: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock.
units.rightText: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock;

units.leftText: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth,
units.rightText: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth,

units.leftText: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord.
units.rightText: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord:

units.leftText: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me,
units.rightText: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me,

units.leftText: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets
units.rightText: Let the wicked fall into their own nets,

units.leftText: I cry with my voice to the LORD.
units.rightText: I cry with my voice unto Jehovah;

units.leftText: I pour out my complaint before him.
units.rightText: I pour out my complaint before him;

units.leftText: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me,
units.rightText: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me,

units.leftText: Look on my right, and see;
units.rightText: Look on my right hand, and see;

units.leftText: I cried to you, LORD.
units.rightText: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah;

units.leftText: Listen to my cry,
units.rightText: Attend unto my cry;

units.leftText: Bring my soul out of prison,
units.rightText: Bring my soul out of prison,

units.leftText: Hear my prayer, LORD.
units.rightText: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications:

units.leftText: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant,
units.rightText: And enter not into judgment with thy servant;

units.leftText: For the enemy pursues my soul.
units.rightText: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul;

units.leftText: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me.
units.rightText: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me;

units.leftText: I remember the days of old.
units.rightText: I remember the days of old;

units.leftText: I spread out my hands to you.
units.rightText: I spread forth my hands unto thee:

units.leftText: Hurry to answer me, LORD.
units.rightText: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth:

units.leftText: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning,
units.rightText: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning;

units.leftText: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies.
units.rightText: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies:

units.leftText: Teach me to do your will,
units.rightText: Teach me to do thy will;

units.leftText: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake.
units.rightText: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name’s sake:

units.leftText: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies,
units.rightText: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies,

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, my rock,
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah my rock,

units.leftText: my loving kindness, my fortress,
units.rightText: My lovingkindness, and my fortress,

units.leftText: LORD, what is man, that you care for him?
units.rightText: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him?

units.leftText: Man is like a breath.
units.rightText: Man is like to vanity:

units.leftText: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down.
units.rightText: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down:

units.leftText: Throw out lightning, and scatter them.
units.rightText: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them;

units.leftText: Stretch out your hand from above,
units.rightText: Stretch forth thy hand from above;

units.leftText: whose mouths speak deceit,
units.rightText: Whose mouth speaketh deceit,

units.leftText: I will sing a new song to you, God.
units.rightText: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God:

units.leftText: You are he who gives salvation to kings,
units.rightText: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings;

units.leftText: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners,
units.rightText: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens,

units.leftText: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants,
units.rightText: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth,

units.leftText: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision.
units.rightText: When our garners are full, affording all manner of store,

units.leftText: Our oxen will pull heavy loads.
units.rightText: When our oxen are well laden;

units.leftText: Happy are the people who are in such a situation.
units.rightText: Happy is the people that is in such a case;

units.leftText: I will exalt you, my God, the King.
units.rightText: I will extol thee, my God, O King;

units.leftText: Every day I will praise you.
units.rightText: Every day will I bless thee;

units.leftText: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised!
units.rightText: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised;

units.leftText: One generation will commend your works to another,
units.rightText: One generation shall laud thy works to another,

units.leftText: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor,
units.rightText: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor,

units.leftText: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts.
units.rightText: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts;

units.leftText: They will utter the memory of your great goodness,
units.rightText: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness,

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious, merciful,
units.rightText: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful;

units.leftText: The LORD is good to all.
units.rightText: Jehovah is good to all;

units.leftText: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD.
units.rightText: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah;

units.leftText: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom,
units.rightText: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom,

units.leftText: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts,
units.rightText: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts,

units.leftText: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom.
units.rightText: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,

units.leftText: The LORD upholds all who fall,
units.rightText: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall,

units.leftText: The eyes of all wait for you.
units.rightText: The eyes of all wait for thee;

units.leftText: You open your hand,
units.rightText: Thou openest thy hand,

units.leftText: The LORD is righteous in all his ways,
units.rightText: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways,

units.leftText: The LORD is near to all those who call on him,
units.rightText: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him,

units.leftText: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him.
units.rightText: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him;

units.leftText: The LORD preserves all those who love him,
units.rightText: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him;

units.leftText: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD.
units.rightText: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 146:1 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: While I live, I will praise the LORD.
units.rightText: While I live will I praise Jehovah:

units.leftText: Don’t put your trust in princes,
units.rightText: Put not your trust in princes,

units.leftText: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth.
units.rightText: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth;

units.leftText: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help,
units.rightText: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help,

units.leftText: who made heaven and earth,
units.rightText: Who made heaven and earth,

units.leftText: who executes justice for the oppressed;
units.rightText: Who executeth justice for the oppressed;

units.leftText: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind.
units.rightText: Jehovah openeth the eyes of the blind;

units.leftText: The LORD preserves the foreigners.
units.rightText: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners;

units.leftText: The LORD will reign forever;
units.rightText: Jehovah will reign for ever,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD,
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah;
leftNotes: 147:1 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: The LORD builds up Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem;
leftNotes: 147:2 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: He heals the broken in heart,
units.rightText: He healeth the broken in heart,

units.leftText: He counts the number of the stars.
units.rightText: He counteth the number of the stars;

units.leftText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power.
units.rightText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power;

units.leftText: The LORD upholds the humble.
units.rightText: Jehovah upholdeth the meek:

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving.
units.rightText: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving;

units.leftText: who covers the sky with clouds,
units.rightText: Who covereth the heavens with clouds,

units.leftText: He provides food for the livestock,
units.rightText: He giveth to the beast his food,

units.leftText: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse.
units.rightText: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse:

units.leftText: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him,
units.rightText: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem!
units.rightText: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem;

units.leftText: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates.
units.rightText: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates;

units.leftText: He makes peace in your borders.
units.rightText: He maketh peace in thy borders;

units.leftText: He sends out his commandment to the earth.
units.rightText: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth;

units.leftText: He gives snow like wool,
units.rightText: He giveth snow like wool;

units.leftText: He hurls down his hail like pebbles.
units.rightText: He casteth forth his ice like morsels:

units.leftText: He sends out his word, and melts them.
units.rightText: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them:

units.leftText: He shows his word to Jacob,
units.rightText: He showeth his word unto Jacob,

units.leftText: He has not done this for just any nation.
units.rightText: He hath not dealt so with any nation;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 148:1 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Praise him, all his angels!
units.rightText: Praise ye him, all his angels:

units.leftText: Praise him, sun and moon!
units.rightText: Praise ye him, sun and moon:

units.leftText: Praise him, you heavens of heavens,
units.rightText: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens,

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD’s name,
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of Jehovah;

units.leftText: He has also established them forever and ever.
units.rightText: He hath also established them for ever and ever:

units.leftText: Praise the LORD from the earth,
units.rightText: Praise Jehovah from the earth,

units.leftText: lightning and hail, snow and clouds,
units.rightText: Fire and hail, snow and vapor;

units.leftText: mountains and all hills,
units.rightText: Mountains and all hills;

units.leftText: wild animals and all livestock,
units.rightText: Beasts and all cattle;

units.leftText: kings of the earth and all peoples,
units.rightText: Kings of the earth and all peoples;

units.leftText: both young men and maidens,
units.rightText: Both young men and virgins;

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD’s name,
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of Jehovah;

units.leftText: He has lifted up the horn of his people,
units.rightText: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 149:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them.
units.rightText: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him:

units.leftText: Let them praise his name in the dance!
units.rightText: Let them praise his name in the dance:

units.leftText: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people.
units.rightText: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people:

units.leftText: Let the saints rejoice in honor.
units.rightText: Let the saints exult in glory:

units.leftText: May the high praises of God be in their mouths,
units.rightText: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth,

units.leftText: to execute vengeance on the nations,
units.rightText: To execute vengeance upon the nations,

units.leftText: to bind their kings with chains,
units.rightText: To bind their kings with chains,

units.leftText: to execute on them the written judgment.
units.rightText: To execute upon them the judgment written:

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 150:1 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Praise him for his mighty acts!
units.rightText: Praise him for his mighty acts:

units.leftText: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet!
units.rightText: Praise him with trumpet sound:

units.leftText: Praise him with tambourine and dancing!
units.rightText: Praise him with timbrel and dance:

units.leftText: Praise him with loud cymbals!
units.rightText: Praise him with loud cymbals:

units.leftText: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah.
leftNotes: 150:6 Hebrew: יה Yah
